title: Tell warp from weft
description: On a woven cloth, point to the threads that run the length and the threads that run across.
oneStarDescription: Point to the finished side edge if there is one.
twoStarDescription: Point to the threads that run along that edge.
threeStarDescription: Point to the threads that cross them.

title: Thin seedlings you sowed
description: Remove extra seedlings so the ones you keep have space, and say how you chose.
oneStarDescription: Point to a crowded patch.
twoStarDescription: Say which seedling you will keep and why, such as the stronger stem.
threeStarDescription: Remove the extras and show the space.

title: Thread a needle and knot the thread
description: Thread a needle, knot the end, and show the knot does not pull through.
oneStarDescription: Pass the thread through the eye.
twoStarDescription: Tie a knot in the long end.
threeStarDescription: Pull the thread against scrap and show the knot holds.

title: Tie a netting knot
description: Tie a netting knot that joins two loops of cord and holds a light tug.
oneStarDescription: Form two loops of cord. A second person can see that this step happened: make two loops.
twoStarDescription: Tie the knot that locks the loops.
threeStarDescription: Tug lightly and show the loops stayed joined.

title: Tie a stem to a stake
description: Tie a soft tie so a stem is supported and not choked.
oneStarDescription: Put the stake in without slicing the stem.
twoStarDescription: Tie a soft tie you can slide a finger under.
threeStarDescription: Show that the stem is not pinched.

title: Turn on captions and read a line
description: Turn on captions for a short clip and read one line aloud as it appears.
oneStarDescription: Find the caption control and turn it on.
twoStarDescription: Read a line that appears.
threeStarDescription: If a line is wrong or missing, say so.

title: Undo a find-and-replace
description: Replace a word in a copy of a note, then undo it and show the original word.
oneStarDescription: Open a copy, not the only file.
twoStarDescription: Replace one word you chose.
threeStarDescription: Undo and show the first word returned.

title: Use one shortcut until it sticks
description: Use one keyboard shortcut three times for the same action, without the mouse.
oneStarDescription: Say the keys and the action.
twoStarDescription: Do the action with the keys.
threeStarDescription: Do it twice more without looking up the keys.

title: Wait for the walk sign
description: At a crossing with a signal, wait until the walk sign shows and say what you did when it did not.
oneStarDescription: Point to the walk signal, not the cars' light only.
twoStarDescription: Stay on the curb while it says wait.
threeStarDescription: Cross only when it says walk, or say you stayed because it did not.

title: Walk with a book on your head
description: Walk a short line with a light book balanced on your head and say when it falls.
oneStarDescription: Balance it while you stand.
twoStarDescription: Walk a few steps. A second person can see that this step happened: walk.
threeStarDescription: Finish the line, or say the step where it fell.

title: Watch a point of light move
description: Watch a steady point of light cross the sky and say whether it moved like a plane or stayed with the stars.
oneStarDescription: Point to one light that is not flashing in your eyes.
twoStarDescription: Watch it against a fixed landmark.
threeStarDescription: Say whether it crossed quickly or stayed with the star field.

title: Watch for a satellite pass
description: Use a prediction or a known time, watch the sky, and say whether a steady light crossed.
oneStarDescription: Write the time you will watch.
twoStarDescription: Watch the part of the sky you chose.
threeStarDescription: Say whether a steady light crossed, and that you are not naming a craft.

title: Tell a web from a nest
description: Point to a web and a nest, or say which one you cannot find.
oneStarDescription: Point to a web or a nest you can see without climbing.
twoStarDescription: Say web or nest and one clue.
threeStarDescription: Step back and say you will not touch it.

title: Wind a bobbin evenly
description: Wind thread onto a bobbin so it does not pile on one side.
oneStarDescription: Catch the thread on the bobbin.
twoStarDescription: Move the thread from side to side as you wind.
threeStarDescription: Show that both ends of the bobbin have thread, not a lump in the middle only.

title: Write a catalog card
description: Write three fields for one object: what it is, where it is, and a date or a blank you will not invent.
oneStarDescription: Write what it is in a few words.
twoStarDescription: Write the shelf, box, or place.
threeStarDescription: Write a date you know, or leave the date blank.

title: Write alt text for one image
description: Write one sentence that says what an image shows, and leave out a guess about why.
oneStarDescription: Look at the image. A second person can see that this step happened: look.
twoStarDescription: Write what is visible. A second person can see that this step happened: write the sentence.
threeStarDescription: Remove or avoid a motive you cannot see.

title: Write three bird sounds as words
description: Write three sounds you hear as your own syllables, without a species name.
oneStarDescription: Write one sound as syllables.
twoStarDescription: Write three, and mark one you heard only once.
threeStarDescription: Hear one again and point to the line you wrote, or say it was new.

title: Zip three files and open them
description: Put three files in one archive, open it, and show the three names.
oneStarDescription: Name the three files. A second person can see that this step happened: choose three.
twoStarDescription: Create one archive that holds them.
threeStarDescription: Open the archive and read the three names.

title: Agree a starting note and hum it
description: Show a music-practice result: hum the note someone gives you and stop.
oneStarDescription: Arrange yourself so you can hum the note someone gives you and stop.
twoStarDescription: Do this once, so another person can hear or see it: hum the note someone gives you and stop.
threeStarDescription: Stop when the result is done, without adding a second trick: hum the note someone gives you and stop.

title: Air a room and then close the window
description: Open a window long enough to change the air and then close it.
oneStarDescription: Set up what you need so you can do this: Open a window long enough to change the air and then close it.
twoStarDescription: Complete it once so someone else can see the result: air a room and then close the window.
threeStarDescription: Stop when the result is done and leave the place usable.

title: Ask the price with a phrase you know
description: Show this result: ask and listen for the number.
oneStarDescription: Look at what you will change, then start: ask and listen for the number.
twoStarDescription: Make the change so someone else can check it: ask and listen for the number.
threeStarDescription: Leave the work so the next person can see what you did: ask and listen for the number.

title: Ask what one word means
description: Show a language result: point to the word and ask a person or a dictionary what it means.
oneStarDescription: Pick a short text you may use and prepare to point to the word and ask a person or a dictionary what it means.
twoStarDescription: Do this once: point to the word and ask a person or a dictionary what it means.
threeStarDescription: Stop when you reach a word you will not guess. You did this: point to the word and ask a person or a dictionary what it means.

title: Bag a spare lead by the door
description: Show this result: put a spare lead in one place you can find in the dark.
oneStarDescription: Set up so a watcher can see you start: put a spare lead in one place you can find in the dark.
twoStarDescription: Finish this once, and leave it as it is: put a spare lead in one place you can find in the dark.
threeStarDescription: Say what you did not do, after this result: put a spare lead in one place you can find in the dark.

title: Bind a cord end with thread
description: Show a materials result: wrap thread over the end and knot it so the cord does not fray in your hand.
oneStarDescription: Use scrap and set up so you can wrap thread over the end and knot it so the cord does not fray in your hand.
twoStarDescription: Finish this result: wrap thread over the end and knot it so the cord does not fray in your hand.
threeStarDescription: Put the tool down and show the result: wrap thread over the end and knot it so the cord does not fray in your hand.

title: Bounce a table-tennis ball on a bat
description: Keep a table-tennis ball bouncing on a bat for several hits.
oneStarDescription: Set up what you need so you can do this: Keep a table-tennis ball bouncing on a bat for several hits.
twoStarDescription: Complete it once so someone else can see the result: bounce a table-tennis ball on a bat.
threeStarDescription: Stop when the result is done and leave the place usable.

title: Bow or nod at the end of a piece
description: Show this result: finish the last sound and then bow or nod once.
oneStarDescription: Set up so a watcher can see you start: finish the last sound and then bow or nod once.
twoStarDescription: Finish this once, and leave it as it is: finish the last sound and then bow or nod once.
threeStarDescription: Say what you did not do, after this result: finish the last sound and then bow or nod once.

title: Breathe on a rest instead of guessing the next note
description: Show a music-practice result: point to a rest and take the breath there.
oneStarDescription: Arrange yourself so you can point to a rest and take the breath there.
twoStarDescription: Do this once, so another person can hear or see it: point to a rest and take the breath there.
threeStarDescription: Stop when the result is done, without adding a second trick: point to a rest and take the breath there.

title: Bring a bin back in after collection
description: Bring it in and close the lid.
oneStarDescription: Start in a way someone can see: bring it in and close the lid.
twoStarDescription: Complete the result once: bring it in and close the lid.
threeStarDescription: Leave or hand on the result so another person can check it: bring it in and close the lid.

title: Brush a pet and stop when it moves away
description: Show a calm pet-care result: brush a few strokes, pause, and stop if the animal leaves.
oneStarDescription: Get what you need and start so you can brush a few strokes, pause, and stop if the animal leaves.
twoStarDescription: Complete this result in one try: brush a few strokes, pause, and stop if the animal leaves.
threeStarDescription: Leave the animal and the place so someone else can see that you did brush a few strokes, pause, and stop if the animal leaves.

title: Call a dog to come and reward the return
description: Call a dog back to you and reward it for arriving, in a place where it cannot run into a road.
oneStarDescription: In a secure room or garden, call once and reward the dog when it reaches you.
twoStarDescription: Give the reward after the dog arrives, not while it is still going away.
threeStarDescription: If the dog does not come, stop the lesson rather than chasing it.

title: Change a pet's water and leave the bowl
description: Show a calm pet-care result: empty the old water, refill the bowl, and put it back where the pet can reach it.
oneStarDescription: Get what you need and start so you can empty the old water, refill the bowl, and put it back where the pet can reach it.
twoStarDescription: Complete this result in one try: empty the old water, refill the bowl, and put it back where the pet can reach it.
threeStarDescription: Leave the animal and the place so someone else can see that you did empty the old water, refill the bowl, and put it back where the pet can reach it.

title: Check a collar fit with two fingers
description: Show a calm pet-care result: slide two fingers under the collar and loosen it if they do not fit.
oneStarDescription: Get what you need and start so you can slide two fingers under the collar and loosen it if they do not fit.
twoStarDescription: Complete this result in one try: slide two fingers under the collar and loosen it if they do not fit.
threeStarDescription: Leave the animal and the place so someone else can see that you did slide two fingers under the collar and loosen it if they do not fit.

title: Check a gate before you unclip a lead
description: Show this result: shut the gate, tug it, and only then unclip.
oneStarDescription: Set up so a watcher can see you start: shut the gate, tug it, and only then unclip.
twoStarDescription: Finish this once, and leave it as it is: shut the gate, tug it, and only then unclip.
threeStarDescription: Say what you did not do, after this result: shut the gate, tug it, and only then unclip.

title: Check one app permission and leave it
description: Show a small account-safety result: open the permission list, name one access the app has, and leave the setting as you found it unless you meant to change it.
oneStarDescription: Find the screen where you can open the permission list, name one access the app has, and leave the setting as you found it unless you meant to change it.
twoStarDescription: Do it on an account or device you control: open the permission list, name one access the app has, and leave the setting as you found it unless you meant to change it.
threeStarDescription: Say what you did not change, after you open the permission list, name one access the app has, and leave the setting as you found it unless you meant to change it.

title: Check the address before you type a password
description: Show this result: read the site name in the address bar and stop if it is not the service you meant.
oneStarDescription: Set up so a watcher can see you start: read the site name in the address bar and stop if it is not the service you meant.
twoStarDescription: Finish this once, and leave it as it is: read the site name in the address bar and stop if it is not the service you meant.
threeStarDescription: Say what you did not do, after this result: read the site name in the address bar and stop if it is not the service you meant.

title: Check you have keys before the door shuts
description: Show the keys and then shut the door.
oneStarDescription: Start in a way someone can see: show the keys and then shut the door.
twoStarDescription: Complete the result once: show the keys and then shut the door.
threeStarDescription: Leave or hand on the result so another person can check it: show the keys and then shut the door.

title: Clamp two pieces with a rubber band
description: Show a materials result: glue is optional; hold two pieces with a band until they stay aligned.
oneStarDescription: Use scrap and set up so you can glue is optional; hold two pieces with a band until they stay aligned.
twoStarDescription: Finish this result: glue is optional; hold two pieces with a band until they stay aligned.
threeStarDescription: Put the tool down and show the result: glue is optional; hold two pieces with a band until they stay aligned.

title: Clap the notes and stay silent on the rest
description: Show this result: clap a short pattern and leave the rest empty.
oneStarDescription: Look at what you will change, then start: clap a short pattern and leave the rest empty.
twoStarDescription: Make the change so someone else can check it: clap a short pattern and leave the rest empty.
threeStarDescription: Leave the work so the next person can see what you did: clap a short pattern and leave the rest empty.

title: Clap your part of a two-part round
description: Show a music-practice result: clap only your line while the other person claps the other line.
oneStarDescription: Arrange yourself so you can clap only your line while the other person claps the other line.
twoStarDescription: Do this once, so another person can hear or see it: clap only your line while the other person claps the other line.
threeStarDescription: Stop when the result is done, without adding a second trick: clap only your line while the other person claps the other line.

title: Clip a lead on and wait at the door
description: Show a calm pet-care result: clip the lead, wait until the animal is standing still, then open the door.
oneStarDescription: Get what you need and start so you can clip the lead, wait until the animal is standing still, then open the door.
twoStarDescription: Complete this result in one try: clip the lead, wait until the animal is standing still, then open the door.
threeStarDescription: Leave the animal and the place so someone else can see that you did clip the lead, wait until the animal is standing still, then open the door.
